_comment: Canonical current catalog for every governed dataset, model and reference asset. It is the only live source for identity, lifecycle, acquisition status, access limits, revisions and local verification. The original June/July frozen baseline remains embedded as the frozen-baseline profile; non-baseline and planned assets are in asset_catalog. Large bytes live under SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR and are never committed.
generated: 2026-08-04; five public assets closed by official-source verification; active study profiles renamed and narrowed to speech-only while cross-domain bytes remain local

profiles.frozen-baseline: The reproducible June/July baseline; default fetch profile for backward compatibility.
profiles.local-candidates: Observed non-baseline local assets; presence does not authorize an experiment.
profiles.speech-aware-core: Earnings21, Earnings22 and ConEC Stage-2A minimum speech-domain closure.
profiles.speech-aware-diagnostics: PRISM, Rare5k and BuzzWord speech/entity diagnostic carriers.
profiles.speech-aware-secondary: SLUE-SQA-5, ContextASR-Bench and AMI public secondary speech carriers.
profiles.speech-aware-annotations: TED-EL annotations only; TED-LIUM3 speech audio remains source-unstable.
profiles.speech-aware-small-public: Small optional speech assets: ATCO2-1h, Eka-Medical and LibriSQA.
profiles.retained-cross-domain: Locally complete general/environmental-audio assets retained for reuse but excluded from the speech-aware study.
profiles.deferred: Cataloged but intentionally not in the current acquisition wave.

status_model.COMPLETE: Required bytes for this record are present at the recorded identity.
status_model.PARTIAL: Some bytes or metadata are present but the record is not complete.
status_model.MISSING: No governed local copy is present.
status_model.BLOCKED: Acquisition is prevented by access, source stability, publication or privacy constraints.

acquisition_policy.rule: Datasets larger than 1 TB are excluded from acquisition and from the active research reference set; retain only a tombstone catalog record so they cannot silently re-enter scope.

amendments.task: official-source dataset closure and canonical lock refresh

changes.note: Closed five formerly partial public assets after exact payload closure and source-appropriate full verification; none is promoted to a speech-aware core-start gate.
Corrected the AudioSet aggregate expected size from 2694310385 to 2694320385 bytes; the seven governed per-object sizes and hashes were already correct and sum to the corrected value.
Removed seven obsolete Hugging Face .incomplete duplicate cache files after ContextASR-Bench payload hash closure; governed payload files were untouched.

aime24/aime25/aime26 and seed-tts-eval were misfiled as "task": "asr" (a copy/paste leftover from the modelscope-manual fetch template; their factor_family was always correct). Corrected in place: aime24/aime25/aime26 -> "task": "text-reasoning-eval"; seed-tts-eval -> "task": "tts-eval". No revision/size/source field was touched.

Enumerating (not changing) the 10/28 dataset entries whose "revision" is unpinned/content-fingerprint-only rather than a real pinned commit/tag -- i.e. "revision" contains "unpinned -- content-fingerprinted" (modelscope master, no tag) or "unknown (no local metadata -- content-fingerprinted)" (source gave no version metadata at all). These are frozen the same way as every other entry (size_bytes + files fingerprint), just without an upstream revision string to re-pin against.

models.name: qwen3-omni-30b-a3b-instruct-gguf
models.note: Q8_0 GGUF + bf16 mmproj for llama.cpp -- the W1 genuine best-of-N engine (30B on 24 GB via -ngl 28); file-selective fetch via scripts/data/fetch-qwen3-omni-gguf.sh (whole-repo pull >110 GB deliberately avoided)

models.name: qwen3-omni-30b-a3b-instruct-gguf-q4km
models.note: Q4_K_M GGUF + the same bf16 mmproj (copied), for the speech-aware-evidence-acquisition study. Admitted on the owner's 2026-08-09 session directive to run experiments on an INT4 model. Provenance chain closed: source Q8_0 sha256 8a50e5a7d29ae6a28fea9ca45e3bb0a142e76ec07e6787a7703cd498eb08ffaa and mmproj sha256 f0dfe825fb692d426362b1ac79678fc08daa4758f7151526cad110515f122883 both match ggml-org's published hashes; requant product sha256 0751c279498785c0b07130ae7748038d1e2cfd04617928e4557063807f98066d, byte-size identical to ggml-org's published Q4_K_M (18557053952) with a tensor-for-tensor identical q4_K/q6_K mixture (llama-quantize --dry-run comparison). Fits entirely in 24 GB VRAM (21.6G resident, no CPU-expert offload): measured 16.24 s per 60 s audio slice vs 67.64 s for Q8_0, a 4.17x speedup. Measured Q4-vs-Q8 transcript agreement on 8 dev-split slices: mean WER 1.50% (entity names identical across all slices; divergence concentrated in function words, with one observed digit change) -- see the study's docs/readiness/2026-08-09-* records
